instruction: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.

arguments.note: The key lies to the right of the lock. Move above its bow before turning downward to grasp it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The approach stopped short. Complete the move above the key.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hand is above the key. Begin rotating toward a downward grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 36 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Continue rotating down to reveal the key beneath the wrist camera.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 41 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Complete the downward orientation while restoring the intended position above the key.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is slightly right of the wrist view centre. Approach it while leaving clearance above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow remains toward the near side of the jaws. Shift toward it and approach to just above grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is centred laterally and slightly ahead. Lower toward table grasp height with a small alignment correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow remains between the jaws. Lower the final few millimetres before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close around the key bow at the table-limited grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed against the bow. Lift the key clear of the table for transfer.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The key is lifted securely. Bring it toward the centre and begin tipping its blade downward for a handover.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined turn and travel was refused. Move the lifted key toward the handover area without changing its orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Bring the open left hand toward the exposed near edge of the key bow for transfer, keeping the right hand steady.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 40 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Complete the left-hand approach; the previous motion stopped well short of the held key.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The left wrist shows the bow directly ahead. Approach its near edge while the right hand continues holding it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Advance a few millimetres onto the exposed bow edge and close the receiving hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The receiving jaws contact the bow region. Open the right hand to transfer support to the left.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The key slipped during transfer and is no longer supported. Separate the hands and reopen them to inspect its resting position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The key is outside the current wrist view after slipping. Move the right hand aside to uncover the table and return the left hand home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.hindsight: The receiving hand contacted the donor gripper rather than securely capturing the bow. A transfer should expose a separate grasp region and verify the receiving grasp before releasing the donor.
arguments.reason: The key was lifted but slipped during handover and is no longer visible in the available camera views. I cannot reliably recover and insert it with the remaining motion budget.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.
